name: C · Plate
premise: Cyanotype photogram: the paper-white shadow is the projected frontal area, the orange hairline is its error.

items.title: Tuck, bar, band
items.note: FINAL. S1 2 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. Constructed bar stub reads as handlebar plus front wheel; cleanest head-on read.

items.title: Upright, tuck, bar
items.note: FINAL. S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. A/B with bar: #5C86BC upright head and leg frame the paper tuck. No orange.

items.title: Upright outline, bar
items.note: FINAL. S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. Orange upright outline as the before, paper tuck as the after; busiest at 1024.

items.title: Tuck sun-print, band
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 11. Plain paper tuck, orange band; reads as hooded figure, bike cue weak.

items.title: Upright behind tuck
items.note: S1 1 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 11. A/B shrink: 0676 in #5C86BC under paper 0674, wheel-aligned; ghost mostly hidden.

items.title: Side-on sun-print
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 0 S4 1 S5 0 S6 2 S7 1 = 8. Below bar; kept only as the side-on comparison. Ring wheels = generic bike glyph.

items.title: Tuck on drafting grid
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 11. Same as 01 on the studio graph grid (64 u pitch, no moire at 64 px).

items.title: Band is the upright
items.note: S1 1 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 11. Orange hairline is the upright outline around the tuck (before/after).

items.title: Big tuck, wheel bleeds
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 11. Larger tuck, wheel off the bottom; most mass, still ghost-like.

items.title: Upright, tuck, band
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 2 S6 2 S7 1 = 10. Darker upright under the banded tuck; upright nearly invisible.

items.title: Grid, upright, tuck
items.note: S1 1 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 10. A/B on drafting grid, no band.

items.title: Tuck, bar, band
items.note: S1 2 S2 1 S3 1 S4 2 S5 2 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. Constructed bar stub reads as handlebar plus front wheel; cleanest head-on read.

items.title: Upright, tuck, bar
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. A/B with bar: #5C86BC upright head and leg frame the paper tuck. No orange.

items.title: Upright outline, bar
items.note: S1 2 S2 2 S3 1 S4 2 S5 1 S6 2 S7 2 = 12. Orange upright outline as the before, paper tuck as the after; busiest at 1024.
